content:
It's time to take a look at the latest iPhone 18 Pro cases. Apple's newest products are officially up for pre-order starting this morning, and several major brands are ready. Apple has rolled out a lineup of colorful silicone cases and an all-new TechWoven fabric case, alongside long-time favorites from third-party makers. From an all-new burgundy variant with a built-in stand, to highly grippy customizable models, to top-tier leather from the likes of Nomad and Burton Goods, there's something for everyone. We also have affordable picks from brands like Spigen starting at $14.

Best iPhone 18 Pro Cases

Featured Pick: ESR

ESR's brand new lineup of iPhone 18 Pro cases and accessories has officially launched, featuring premium color options, patented tech, and more. The star of the show is the new Atelier vegan leather MagSafe case with a built-in zinc alloy Flex stand that seamlessly blends into the camera bump for protection, boasts 3× military-grade protection, and is described as "soft and springy for a comfortable grip." Available in four shades, the new Atelier collection and other accessories are perfectly matched to the new Wine, Glacial, Black, and Silver iPhone 18 Pro models.

  • ESR Atelier Vegan Leather MagSafe Case with Flex Stand: $42 (was $46) | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR UltraFit Armorite Pro Screen Protector: $30 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Cyber FlickLock MagSafe Case: $21 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Geo MagSafe Wallet Stand with Grip: $46 (was $50) | Amazon or ESR

Nomad

Nomad is one of the top names in premium leather cases, and all of its flagship iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max models are now ready to go. This year, the brand is also rolling out an all-new Rugged Case lineup, each colorway featuring topographic contour patterns from Baja:

  • Rugged Case: $70
  • Colors: Norte, Balandra, Arroyo
  • Clear Leather: $69
  • Colors: Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black
  • Magnetic Leather Back: $59
  • Colors: Burgundy, Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black, Olde Dublin
  • Sport Case: $55
  • Colors: Black, Driftwood, Rosewood, Lunar Grey
  • Modern Leather Case: $69 to $89
  • Traditional Leather Case: $79 to $99
  • Rugged Leather Case: $79
  • Color: Rustic Brown

Featured Pick: Dbrand

Dbrand has its well-received Grip case ready for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. In addition to offering one of the cleanest designs out there and an extremely grippy texture, it once again fully supports a wide array of customizable skins so you can add your own personal flair; there's also a discount when you pair it with the matching Prism screen protector.

  • Dbrand Grip Case for iPhone 18 Pro/Max: $55. Customizable, drop-proof, super grippy, excellent button feel.
  • Dbrand Prism 2.0 for iPhone 18 Pro/Max, 2-pack: $35 ($5 off when bought with case). Easy install, auto-alignment, fully dust-free.

Dbrand is also rolling out an all-new MNML case lineup this year, starting at $39, delivering minimalist, stylish design at an accessible price, with MagSafe support and the same crisp button feel the brand is known for.

  • Dbrand MNML iPhone 18 Pro/Max Case: $39. Colors: Black, Marine, Tan, Burgundy.

MUJJO Troubadour

  • All-Leather Case for iPhone 18 Series: $59

Burton Goods

***Note: The cases below can be discounted an additional 20% off the already reduced launch prices using our exclusive code 9TO520 at checkout. If the code doesn't work, try DUO10 at checkout instead.

  • Luxury Pocket Book Folio Case for iPhone 18 Pro/Max: $89 (was $119)
  • Heritage Leather Case for iPhone 18 Duo: $60 (was $80)

UAG

UAG has also released several cases for iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, including its signature rugged models with reinforced corners, grippy bumpers, and various drop-proof designs. If you're after a case that can handle harsh environments while still being suitable for everyday protection, UAG's lineup is well worth a look.

  • UAG Mouve for iPhone Duo: $65
  • EGO TACTICAL UAG Urban Armor Gear Pathfinder Case for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max: $80
  • UAG Civilian Grip Case: from $60
  • More...

YETI iPhone 18 Pro/18 Pro Max Cases

If you want a rugged case for your new iPhone but don't want to go with the usual suspects like OtterBox or UAG, YETI's LoadOut lineup is well worth considering. These cases meet MIL-STD-810H drop testing, offer reliable protection, support MagSafe, and come with a built-in rotating kickstand for hands-free use.

Mous

If you're looking for a premium iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max case that doesn't make your phone feel overly bulky, Mous is a strong contender. Mous now offers an ultra-thin Aramid fiber case for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, along with the following models.

  • Mous Limitless MagSafe Case: $75
  • Mous Clear Case: $70
  • Mous Limitless Aramid Fiber Case: $85
  • Mous Slim MagSafe Case: $55
  • Mous Slim Aramid Fiber Case: $70
  • More...

Aulumu

AULUMU's iPhone 18 Pro cases are known for their futuristic designs, edgy style, and slim profile, standing out from the crowd with unique textured finishes.

  • Aulumu A18 Ultra-Thin Aramid Fiber Case: $66
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop Protection Case for iPhone 18 Pro: $60
  • Aulumu A18 Frosted Case: $40

Pitaka

PITAKA cases are ideal for iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max users who prioritize an ultra-slim design. Their products are typically made from lightweight Aramid fiber, featuring a clean and understated look while maintaining MagSafe compatibility, with extra protection around the camera and edges.

  • Pitaka Edge Aramid Fiber Woven Case: $60
  • Pitaka Summa Military-Grade Drop Aramid Case: $80
  • Pitaka Cairn Rugged Protection Case: $60

OtterBox iPhone 18 Pro Series Cases

OtterBox also offers a wide range of cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, from slim everyday models to heavy-duty rugged designs with reliable protection. Many of the newer models support MagSafe, and some add grippier sides, accessory slots, raised camera protection, and built-in stands, letting you pick based on your preferred thickness and protection level.

  • OtterBox Defender Series Pro: $70
  • OtterBox Commuter Series: $50
  • OtterBox Symmetry Series with Stand: $60
  • OtterBox Sole Series: $60
  • More...

Belkin

Belkin is another solid choice for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, especially for users who prefer minimalist designs and don't want to bulk up their phones, yet don't need a fully rugged case. Their lineup typically includes MagSafe-compatible clear and protective cases with raised edges around the screen and camera, while select models like Protect+ feature reinforced corners for a good balance of everyday protection and slim design.

  • Belkin Clear MagSafe Case: $30
  • Belkin Qi2-Compatible MagSafe Case with Grip: $50
  • Belkin Protect+ Case with Air Cushion Corners: $60
